answer.book: Second part of Gilpin's Daemonologia sacra (1677), a treatise on Satan's temptations; this sheet holds Part II, divided into nine numbered chapters, each with a summary heading.

entries.title: Chap. I. That it is Satan's grand design to corrupt the minds of men with errour. The evidences that it is so. And the reasons of his endeavours that way.
Chap. II. Of the advantages which Satan hath, and useth, for the introduction of errour.
Chap. III. Of Satan's improving these advantages for errour.
Chap. IV. Of Satan's second way of improving his advantages, which is by working upon the understanding indirectly by the affections.
Chap. V. Satan's attempts against the peace of God's children, evidenced.
Chap. VI. Of the various ways by which he hinders peace.
Chap. VII. Of the second way to hinder peace.
Chap. VIII. Of Satan's third way to hinder peace by spiritual sadness.
Chap. IX. Of his fourth way to hinder peace, by spiritual distresses.
